title: Unit Event — Knowing the Unseen — Episode2 Far Beyond Me

meta.Event Outline: Ena debates whether she should aim for art school post-graduation. With this inner turmoil comes restlessness, which begins to affect her art. Mr. Yukihira notices that she's struggling, and after she divulges the cause, he invites her to take part in an excursion.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home.
Dinner will be ready soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'm going up to my room to change.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I really need to make up my mind about that soon.)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: How are things for your exhibit coming along, dear?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, that's wonderful to hear.
I might have to stop by if I get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: You're going to have quite a few of your older works on display, yes?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: This exhibit's sort of meant to be the culmination of my life's work up until now.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'll be looking forward to it.
And I'm sure all the other visitors are also going to enjoy it very much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Getting to create art for a living... Having the masses see and appreciate your work...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm having trouble seeing myself being able to doing that.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've been drawing every day since I decided that I'm going to improve one step at a time. But everyone else is still miles ahead of me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Do I even need to go to art school in the first place?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(If I want to get better...
If I really do want to become an artist, then I probably should.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But can someone like me really do this for a living?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is it okay for me to even apply when I'm feeling like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh... Nothing's wrong.
I'm gonna go get changed now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Okay, my drawing of this statue has nice some depth to it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I seem to be making the same mistake again. It looks crooked just like last time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I see now. The length of each part is uneven which is why it feels imbalanced.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've been practicing what he's been telling me to do, but I can't figure out how to make them second nature...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: As I do each year, I'll be holding a special course on technical mastery for those aiming to get into art school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But can someone like me really do this for a living?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is it okay for me to even apply when I'm feeling like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can't focus. My head's a complete mess...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: The outline of your statue looks lopsided, Shinonome. Are you having trouble focusing?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: So, to summarize, you need to observe your subject as much as possible and put that to paper. This is one of the most fundamental components of art.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: You seemed to completely miss that today. You can hone your craft all you want, but it'll be all for naught if your fundamentals aren't sound.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Also, you seemed to lose focus partway through. Is there something on your mind...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm wondering if I should try to get into an art school.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Tell me this. Why do you wish to go to art school...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I want to become a better artist...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I want to do that and become a professional artist.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I have a proposal for you.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Next weekend, let's have a special lesson outside of class.
